per_piece.piece: Where the detach runs
per_piece.evidence: zoo/zoo_keeper/bpylayer/export.py:22 `export_glb(..., share_textures=True, ...)` and :72-73 `if share_textures: _share_textures(filepath)` -- every Zoo module export externalises its images; zoo/zoo_keeper/core/gltf_textures.py:42 `TEX_DIR = "_tex"`, :147-165 pops each image's bufferView and writes `im["uri"] = f"{tex_dir}/{name}"` with the name carrying sha1 of the pixels, :215-222 an existing same-named file is shared, not rewritten. Zoo CHANGELOG 1.2.0 (line 6205, 'a pack texture is one file, not sixty copies'). The detach landed in Zoo's export, not in Level Factory's export as the 2026-09-05 status proposed.
per_piece.checked: Read export.py whole and gltf_textures.py lines 1-60 and 125-228; read Zoo CHANGELOG 6205-6323.

per_piece.piece: The texture folder travels through assembly and export into the package
per_piece.evidence: Level Factory 0.105.0 (CHANGELOG line 7216, 'a job publishes what its GLBs name, and a gate asks whether the package does'): level_factory/packages/jobs/scheduler.py:212-266 `_with_glb_dependencies` adds every file a collected GLB names via images[].uri, called at :716-719 on every job's outputs; Deli Counter's and Lot's copy sites use `glb_deps.copy_with_deps` (deli_counter/portable_building.py:689 and :714; lot/lot.py:1986; lot/package.py:405); level_factory/packages/exporting/export.py:2579-2599 scans every shipped GLB's references, writes glb_reference_scan.json and raises ExportGlbReferenceError on a missing one. In a package: docs/cold_runs/cold_9378/export.log:17 '[export] glb references: 134 GLB(s), 486 external reference(s): 486 resolve to 209 file(s) in the package, 0 missing, 0 unportable, 0 unreadable GLB(s)'. The 9378 package (workspaces/cold-9378-ws/.level_factory/exports/LF_restaurant_row_001.portable-godot) holds `_tex/` folders under cover/ and every lot/<building>/art/{zoo,dressing,fixtures,roofprops}/.
per_piece.checked: Read scheduler.py 205-266 and 706-725, export.py 2560-2604, glb_refs.py docstring, LF CHANGELOG 7216-7330; grepped DC and Lot for copy_with_deps; grepped cold_9378/export.log; listed the 9378 package's _tex folders.

done_since: Zoo 1.2.0 (2026-09-21) moved the detach into every module export (export.py:72-73, gltf_textures.py:147-165)

Level Factory 0.105.0 (2026-09-22) publishes a GLB's uri dependencies (scheduler.py:212-266, 716-719) and gates the package on them (export.py:2579-2599); proven at 0 missing in cold run 9378 (export.log:17)
proposed_status: *STATUS: CLOSED 2026-10-22 -- the texture leaves the GLB where the module is written and travels with it to the package. Zoo 1.2.0's `export_glb(..., share_textures=True)` (zoo/zoo_keeper/bpylayer/export.py:22, :72-73) rewrites every module's embedded images to `images[].uri` under `_tex/`, each named by a hash of its pixels and written once (zoo_keeper/core/gltf_textures.py:147-165, :215-222), so the detach runs in Zoo's export and not, as this item proposed, in Level Factory's. The folder travels: Level Factory 0.105.0's `scheduler._with_glb_dependencies` publishes whatever a collected GLB names beside it (level_factory/packages/jobs/scheduler.py:212-266, called at :716-719), Deli Counter's and Lot's copy sites carry it (`glb_deps.copy_with_deps`, deli_counter/portable_building.py:689 and :714, lot/lot.py:1986, lot/package.py:405), and the export refuses a package whose GLBs name a file it lacks (packages/exporting/export.py:2579-2599). In a package: cold run 9378's export.log line 17 reads 134 GLBs, 486 external references, 486 resolving to 209 files, 0 missing. What is left is not this item's: the duplication is now per building folder, not per module (9378's package: 451 `_tex/` PNGs, 112 distinct by sha256, one image stored 31 times), which item 28's closing status records and item 238 carries ('one per content per package is estimated at -10 to -12 MiB ... then the deduplication', NARROWED 2026-10-19).*
notes: Extraction artefact: the batch's `body` for 87 runs from 87's heading to the paragraph above 88's heading, so it carries ITEM 88's statuses (the triplanar / .tres override history, lines 10004-10200); 88 itself is CLOSED 2026-09-06 by Level Factory 0.57.0's importer_defaults. Item 87's own statuses are the two paragraphs ABOVE its heading (roadmap lines 9935-9958). Sibling item 28 ('The VRAM question is about zoo's GLB embedding') was CLOSED 2026-10-15 on the same Zoo 1.2.0 change with cold run 9314's package (0 embedded images). Item 166 also records 'Zoo 1.2.0 + LF 0.99.0 stop embedding the same pack texture in every GLB' (roadmap ~17586). Per-folder duplication measured read-only on 9378's package with a hashlib one-liner over `_tex/*.png` outside .godot: 451 files, 14,954,224 B, 112 distinct, 4,684,188 B unique -- the same shape item 238's 2026-10-19 status counted on 9335 (458 files, 118 images) and lists as 'then the deduplication', so the follow-on has a home. The 9378 package's lot_assemble candidates were content-cache hits (cold_9378/art.log:30-32) and its zoo_kit_build jobs ran (art.log:75-76); since LF 0.105.0 a cache hit materialises a GLB's textures with it (scheduler.py:236-238).
